1 — plan-defect: the replacement rig-banner text in `fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_merge.mjs` (lines 724-727 post-patch) misstates what the rig actually does, and the misstatement is transcribed verbatim from the task's Context ("the last code repeating" / "`STUB_MERGE_CODE_2` overrides the second only"). The stub in `fleet/tests/_sandbox_boot_helpers.mjs:233-243` computes `code` as the min(n, len)-th entry, then unconditionally overrides it with `${STUB_MERGE_CODE_2:-200}` whenever `n >= 2 && i < n` — i.e. the last code does NOT repeat past the list; once the list runs out, `STUB_MERGE_CODE_2` (default 200) answers every later PUT. Concretely: `STUB_MERGE_CODE: '405'` with no `_2` answers PUT 2 with 200, not 405 — which is the single most-used shape in this very file (`put405` line 445, `NOT_MERGEABLE` line 841, `merge409`/`merge422`/`merge500` lines 879-881) and is what the file's own comment at line 1744 ("the second PUT defaults to 200") and its correct banner at lines 1921-1925 ("`STUB_MERGE_CODE_2` / `STUB_MERGE_MESSAGE_2` apply to PUT n ≥ 2 only when the list has fewer than n entries") both state. The second clause is wrong the same way: `STUB_MERGE_CODE_2` is not "PUT 2 only" — it answers any PUT n ≥ 2 the list does not cover. The task's own Context calls these comments "the specification of record", and the Claim is that the reworded comments describe the real shape, so a replacement that contradicts the rig and the same file's correct banner does not establish it. Every Proof `Run:` still exits 0 with the corrected wording, since M3 only pins the absence of `the FIRST PUT` and `the second, default 200`, neither of which the fix reintroduces. Path that has to change: `fleet/tests/test_sandbox_boot_merge.mjs`.
